cases.what: Soft Clip at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Hard Clip at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Saturation 1 at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Saturation 2 at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Tube at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Fuzz at the starting values (Drive 25%, +10 dB into the curve): the sine's harmonics and the ramp's curve
Hard Clip, Drive 0: nothing above full level, so the sound is unchanged
Gain 100 (four times the curve), Mix 50%, Volume 5.5 (half)
Resolution 4 bits, Drive 0, Hard Clip: every sample on a step of 1/8
Downsample 4, Drive 0, Hard Clip: each sample held for four
Drive keyed from 0% (frame 0) to 100% (frame 10) on the sine: it grows steadily harsher
frames 5 to 14 of fx_dist_010 alone: the same samples as the whole mix there (the hold counts from the layer's start)
a layer starting at frame 7 with a level of -6 dB, Downsample 3: the hold counts from the layer's start, before the level
two in a row: Fuzz then Soft Clip
a Drive of 150, outside 0 to 100: kept, EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID, the sound unchanged
a type of "crunch", which it does not have: kept, EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID, the sound unchanged

refused.what: Distortion on a solid layer is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID
an expression on a Distortion number is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: sound effects take keys only
a picture Mix on Distortion is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: its wet share is its own Mix setting
